scope: Four named forms of Create Undead in pinned SRD 5.1
limitations: Authored Russian summaries, not official translation or all undead.
Base statistics are structured; attacks, immunities and traits remain text.
Create Undead control, hit point maximum reduction, curses and zombies are not applied automatically.
Ghoul exempts elves from claw paralysis; Ghast does not. Mummy is not Mummy Lord.
